from flask import Flask, request
from database import get_db_connection

app = Flask(__name__)

@app.route("/remove_favorite_recipe", methods=["POST"])
def remove_favorite_recipe():
    user = request.form["user"]
    recipe_id = request.form["recipe_id"]

    conn = get_db_connection()
    cursor = conn.cursor()

    query = "DELETE FROM favorites WHERE user = %s AND recipe_id = %s"

    cursor.execute(query, (user, recipe_id))
    conn.commit()

    return "Recipe removed from favorites!"
